text:
sam.r: Quick sync: Prospect LedgerWave wants a 2-week Dedicated POC. They asked for a single IP allowlist for our dedicated endpoint and want confirmation about POC billing and data controls.
mira.k: Important to clarify: single IP possible if we allocate one EIP, but it's an add-on and carries provisioning lead time + cost. Do they accept a /29 instead? Easier for us to rotate quietly.
sam.r: They specifically asked for one IP to add to their firewall. Legal worried about logs being tied to their tenant for the POC.
eva.ops: We can reserve a single static egress IP for the POC. Process: ops ticket + PO for the egress addon. Lead time typically ~48 hours. IP will remain stable for the POC unless they request reprovisioning. If rotation is needed mid-POC it's a short scheduled window.
jamie.sec: For logs: we can provide tenant-separated usage reports but network flow logs at our infra layer are retained for operations. We can't promise zero short-term operational logs, but we can redact tenant identifiers in exported reports. I'll prepare a statement for Legal. Also, TLS is enforced; server certs are provided. mTLS is only on Private/VPC installs.
taylor.rev: Sales ask: include a clear line item in the quote: "POC static egress (2w)" with explicit cost and procurement steps. Also confirm whether enabling this requires a contract amendment.
mira.k: Ask the customer for: 1) network contact + off-hours, 2) allowed IP/CIDR (if they insist on single IP say so), 3) peak RPS or tokens/sec so we can size capacity, 4) billing contact + PO, 5) data residency restrictions (e.g., must remain in eu-west-1).
sam.r: I'll send an email. Can someone give me a short curl snippet for infra to test once the IPs are live?
eva.ops: Use this minimal test:```
# quick reachability check
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer POC_TOKEN" \ 
  https://dedicated.prod.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"input":"ping"}'
```
sam.r: Perfect. Also the customer asked: any chance for temporary mTLS for POC?
jamie.sec: Short answer: not on hosted Dedicated. We can spin up a private sandbox with mTLS but that adds legal and infra lead time (typically >2w). Recommend the static IP approach for short POC.
taylor.rev: Revenue note: if they convert to reserved Dedicated, we can roll the egress cost into the commitment or offer a waived first-month fee as a conversion incentive.
deploy-bot: PROV-4987 created by eva.ops  Dedicated POC static egress request for ledgerwave-231. ETA 48h.
eva.ops: Once PO is attached to PROV-4987 we'll allocate the EIP and paste IPs here. We'll also include a small runbook for updating allowlists if we need to rotate.
jamie.sec: I'm prepping the SQA attachments (SOC2 pointers, data retention clause, architecture diagram). I'll post them to this thread before you email.
sam.r: Thanks all. I'll draft the customer email and include the required asks + the curl test. Will post the PO once it's in.
